name: EthOS Download Manager
description: HTTP, magnet and debrid downloads with a priority queue, categories, a daily schedule, bandwidth limits and RSS rules — in a native EthOS window.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.1.0: provider slots — a torrent debrid (Real-Debrid / AllDebrid / TorBox) and a hoster-link provider (AllDebrid / tb7.pl) can be active at the same time; the Settings panel lists every provider from the engine catalogue with its own credential fields, Verify button and (for tb7.pl) premium/transfer status and supported hosters; requires EthOS 2.9.0. 1.0.13: per-package speed limit — every package row has a Limit selector (off / 1-50 MB/s) that caps the whole multi-part package with a shared budget instead of each part; requires EthOS 2.3.12. 1.0.12: per-part Skip / Unskip — a broken volume of a multi-part package can be excluded from its part row (and put back later) instead of being deleted, skipped parts are tagged in the package row and never counted as failures; requires EthOS 2.3.11. 1.0.11: mirror / hoster failover — the add form takes alternative URLs (one per line), a dead source or an exhausted retry budget switches to the next mirror with a fresh budget and a restart from byte 0, and the row shows mirror n/m; requires EthOS 2.3.10. 1.0.10: archives unpack themselves after the download when Extract archives after download is on — multi-part packages wait for every part and start at the first volume, Delete archives after a successful extraction is a separate switch, finished rows and packages gain an Extract / Extract again action and show Extracting… / Extracted / Extract failed; requires EthOS 2.3.9. 1.0.9: transient failures retry automatically with exponential backoff (the row shows retry n/max in …), a Retry failed toolbar action re-queues every error, Settings gained retry count/delay and the duplicate policy (rename/skip/overwrite), and re-adding the same URL now says Already in the list; requires EthOS 2.3.8. 1.0.8: packages expand with Show parts — each part keeps Resume/Delete/Details. 1.0.7: multi-part archives group into one JDownloader-style package row; requires EthOS 2.3.6. 1.0.6: declares the optional archive-tools host requirement, so EthOS installs bsdtar (libarchive-tools) for .7z/.rar extraction of downloaded archives; requires EthOS 2.3.5. 1.0.5: bulk Clear failed — removes every errored download record and its leftover .part data (finished files and destination folders stay); requires EthOS 2.3.4. 1.0.4: Package Center icon redrawn on the 256 px grid; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.3: queue ordering works everywhere — whole waiting/paused rows are draggable, ↑/↓ buttons reorder without dragging, a Queue order sort shows the real start order, and a bug that hid the action buttons on every row after the first is fixed; adds Pause all / Resume all / Clear completed and the auto-download-debrid toggle. 1.0.2: matches the shared package shell — a persistent Download button in the window header, a ready/attention status card, numbered add form (source · destination · torrents), table-based categories/RSS/watch folders and a Package panel; the 2 s poll no longer clears the quick-add field. 1.0.1: debrid keys can be verified without re-typing them (the backend uses the saved key for a masked value), provider errors are shown verbatim (e.g. Real-Debrid bad_token, AllDebrid auth errors, TorBox /user/me), and admin-only saves explain the 403. 1.0.0: first release — live queue with drag-and-drop ordering, pause/resume/reset/delete, add via URL, magnet or .torrent, categories, a daily start window, global/per-task speed limits, debrid provider setup, qBittorrent key management, RSS rules and watch folders.
